core_obligations: Choose a surjective etale U -> X with U a scheme, set R = U x_X U and T = Z x_U X (proof lines 2384-2386).
Let Tbar be the scheme theoretic image of T in U and show s^{-1}Tbar = t^{-1}Tbar using flat base change of scheme theoretic images (proof lines 2386-2391).
Descend to a closed subspace Zbar of X whose pullback to U is Tbar (proof lines 2392-2395).
Use the scheme case of the quasi-compact immersion factorization to conclude that T -> Tbar is an open immersion, hence that Z -> Zbar is an open immersion (proof lines 2396-2399).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a quasi-compact immersion Z -> X of algebraic spaces over S factors as Z -> Zbar -> X with Z -> Zbar an open immersion and Zbar -> X a closed immersion (source lines 2374-2381). The proof builds Zbar by descent: on a surjective etale presentation U -> X with R = U x_X U one takes T = Z x_U X and the scheme theoretic image Tbar of T in U, observes that s^{-1}Tbar = t^{-1}Tbar because scheme theoretic images of quasi-compact morphisms commute with flat base change, descends this to a closed subspace Zbar of X, and uses the scheme case for quasi-compact immersions to see that T -> Tbar, hence Z -> Zbar, is an open immersion.
